name: Table captions with the ready-made strip
summary: The strip and a small screen stand on the table. The screen shows what is said, each speaker's number, and which side they are on. Nothing to wear.
notes: Written from Seeed's documents; nobody has built it. The firmware asks the strip's chip for the voice angle and builds cleanly, but has not run on this board. Not yet checked: which end of the strip counts as 0 degrees, and whether the chip needs its sound clock running. A straight row of microphones cannot tell ahead from behind. The screen's four wires are soldered to the small board, because this board has no plug for it; where best to solder them is unchecked too. A table does not turn, so no motion sensor is needed.
